name: Rosaelva Lomeli
office: Rio Hondo Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Science teacher Rosaelva Lomeli is a Río Hondo Community College District trustee elected in 2018. The district earned an Aa1 bond rating upgrade. It passed a balanced 2026-2027 budget with $70 million in reserves. She supports expanding workforce and transfer pathways. The college foundation received a $500,000 county investment for student housing and food. In 2021, she signed a resolution reaffirming support for diversity in faculty and staff hiring.
